consequence: predictive_orthonormal loses target power against production at the named plants. The condition is not met for ADNI, and it stays an opt-in diagnostic. The measurement-visibility page records which differences its two measured dimensions give up at ADNI's design. In every verdict the SEA-AD anchor's reading stands for SEA-AD's design, keep_production stands, and the out-of-span cells are reported beside the verdict and were not judged.

consequences.gate_failed: No reading is interpreted. The cause is fixed and the affected units are rerun under the same rule.
consequences.no_gain: No simulated target cell at ADNI's table gains at the family threshold, so the measured dimension buys nothing at ADNI's design in simulation. The condition is not met, and it stays an opt-in diagnostic. A gain recorded on ADNI's noise without a simulated one is a lead on the simulation of ADNI's design, not a qualification.
consequences.power_loss: predictive_orthonormal loses target power against production at the named plants. The condition is not met for ADNI, and it stays an opt-in diagnostic. The measurement-visibility page records which differences its two measured dimensions give up at ADNI's design.
consequences.production_excess: Production's unrestricted null with df exceeds size on a control at the named readings. No reading of predictive_orthonormal is interpreted. A diagnosis of that control comes before any other reading on ADNI. If the control is a translation on ADNI's blocks, the roadmap states that a group main effect along the stage program reaches the interaction statistics at ADNI's design.
consequences.reopened: At ADNI's design predictive_orthonormal holds size on the added controls, loses no target power, adds no off-target rejection where the truth is exact, and gains over production in simulation. With item 21's size reading, open item 1's second reopening condition is met for ADNI's export at 750 participants and the full cohort. It stays an opt-in diagnostic: a separate change may propose its paper-grade run with a rank rule for a fixed measured dimension, and only that run can change a default.
consequences.size_excess: predictive_orthonormal exceeds size on a control this change adds, where production holds. Item 21's hold on the global null does not extend to that control. Open item 1's second reopening condition is not met for ADNI, and it stays an opt-in diagnostic.
consequences.specificity_excess: predictive_orthonormal adds off-target rejections over production at the named cells, where the kind of the planted difference is known exactly. The condition is not met for ADNI, and it stays an opt-in diagnostic.

recorded_gains.note: judged by G's rule and recorded; they never qualify the candidate

descriptive.note: Every table here is a reading beside the verdict and production's statement and never changes them.

licenses.L1: The reading speaks for ADNI's export, the two design points and the simulated table. Nothing is extended to 80, 200 or 500 participants, where only size was read.
licenses.L2: At the full cohort, power and specificity were read on in-sample plants and in simulation. No held-out plant exists there. The held-out readings are those of 750 participants.
licenses.L3: reopened permits a proposal. It changes no default and adds no option. The later change carries the rank rule open item 1 asks for.
licenses.L4: Cohorts do not vouch for one another. The SEA-AD veto stands for SEA-AD's design, and ROSMAP has no reading.
licenses.L5: The out-of-span cells license nothing. Outside the stage span the split test's complement is the detector, and its reading on ADNI's noise is not this change's.

reproduction.rule: the cohort anchor's available and rejected counts for the four arms equal the anchor run's committed rate table

scoping_rule.S1: A size reading speaks for its export and its design points. The points are declared before the run. Nothing is interpolated between them or extended beyond them.
scoping_rule.S2: An option's scope on a cohort is its size scope (design D8). An option with no scope there is not admissible on that cohort.
scoping_rule.S3: Cohorts do not vouch for one another. A hold on one export does not lift a failure on another and does not extend to a cohort without its own reading. The SEA-AD anchor's reading stands for SEA-AD's design.
scoping_rule.S4: Size is one of three readings. Reopening an option at a design also needs a gain over production at that design in simulation and specificity there, each under a decision declared before its reading. Reopening means that a separate change may propose its paper-grade run; only that run can change a default.
scoping_rule.S5: Covariates describe; they do not extend. Features per participant, the selected ranks and the in-sample stage fit are reported beside a scope. They license no reading at a design that was not read.

standing: In every verdict the SEA-AD anchor's reading stands for SEA-AD's design, keep_production stands, and the out-of-span cells are reported beside the verdict and were not judged.
